=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- CLAUDE.md:1888 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The §26.C step 5 paragraph fails to restate three critical rules from the §26.C step 5 session rules in the instructions prompt: (a) The checker never archives itself either; the fixer archives it, (b) a SUCCEEDED hand-back counts as delivered even before the fixer claims the head, and (c) first re-run step 1's command and start the fresh fixer only while action is still hand_back_fixer.
  WHY: A new Sonnet checker session, which starts with `/effort low` and no other context, will not be aware of these rules. This leads to the checker attempting to rename/archive itself, misinterpreting delivered hand-backs as gone, or starting duplicate fixers (the original PR #4704 incident).
- Requirement: “Final PR” header in `docs/implement-plan/issue-4787-checker-renames-only-itself.md` must accurately identify the PR under review.
  Expected change site: `docs/implement-plan/issue-4787-checker-renames-only-itself.md:6`
  Evidence of absence: The header currently says “Final PR: #4797 draft”, but the PR under review is #4828. This is misleading for downstream tools/readers.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- Requirement: Project log header must identify the PR under review. The log is the canonical resume state; every place downstream that reads `Final PR` from `docs/implement-plan/issue-4787-checker-renames-only-itself.md` (issue progress comments, the §26 hand-back prompt, the `--resume.` block, the chain resume prompt) must resolve to the PR actually carrying this work.
  Expected change site: `docs/implement-plan/issue-4787-checker-renames-only-itself.md:6` (`Final PR: …` line).
  Evidence of absence: This PR's diff edits line 6 from `Final PR: draft (opened right after this commit; number in the issue progress comment)` to `Final PR: #4797 draft`. The same log's lines 10, 14, and 17 consistently identify #4828 as the current phase 1 PR (`Waiting on: PR #4828 twin sync…`, `Last note: … PR #4828 carries a hold claim…`, `Phase 1 — PR #4828 open (held for twin sync)`), and the PR description confirms this work is on PR #4828. `Final PR: #4797` therefore points at a PR number that does not carry this work, so a `/resume.` or hand-back read on a later cycle would target the wrong PR URL. The value should be `#4828 draft` (or revert to the placeholder until the supervising session numbers it).
  SEVERITY: MAJOR | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- Requirement: §26.B step 3 says the checker instructions prompt restates the §26.C step 5 session rules so a new Sonnet checker, which starts with `/effort low` and no other context, can apply them without re-reading CLAUDE.md. The plan goal #1 lists the §26.B step 3 rules as “own-id line, never target a subscriber, §26.D title check via get_session, archive reported only on success, delivered/gone rule, re-check before a fresh fixer” — six distinct rules derived from §26.C step 5.
  Expected change site: `CLAUDE.md` lines 1794-1798 (§26.B step 3 paragraph that begins “The prompt also restates the session rules of §26.C step 5”).
  Evidence of absence: The new paragraph at CLAUDE.md:1794-1798 enumerates only three of the six §26.C step 5 rules: (a) own id from Bash, (b) never pass a subscriber's id to `set_session_title`/`archive_session`, and (c) missing Routine alone is not gone. It omits (d) “The checker never archives itself either; the fixer archives it (§26.D)”, (e) “delivered, even when the fixer has not claimed the head yet”, and (f) “first re-run step 1's command and start the fresh fixer only when `action` is still `hand_back_fixer`”. The contract test `test_instructions_prompt_restates_the_session_rules` (tests/test_check_in_session_targeting.py) only pins the prose marker and the missing-Routine sentence, so the omission is not caught by tests. An operator following only §26.B step 3 would build an instructions prompt that misses rules (d), (e), and (f); rules (e) and (f) are the ones the PR #4704 incident was about (hand-back Routine missing → fresh fixer started, when re-checking the PR state would have shown the head was already being worked on).
  SEVERITY: MAJOR | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
